name: Jasmin
source:
Favorite undies: Chemise
Favorite season: Summer
Hobby: Dancing
Favorite Color: Orange

Jasmin is the oldest of the new applicants to work at the store.

Unlike the others, she has been working for the past couple of years as a dancer and is currently not enrolled in college.

Jasmin however wants to move on with her life, get a new job, and find a better balance between her passions and work.

[Taken from [url=http://i.imgur.com/Awf0Tqs.png]Character Bio Sheet[/url]]
